QUALITY ASSURED: one-year hassle-free replacement plus Lifetime Limited Warranty
description: This KitchenAid Bamboo Spoon Spatula is ideal for sautéing, plus folding in ingredients and scooping. The smart design of the flexible, silicone head features curved sides for scraping even hard to reach areas. The head is also heat-resistant to 500F. Made from eco-friendly, sustainable bamboo, this spatula is safe to use on all cookware, including nonstick. Lifetime Limited Warranty. Hand wash only.
